Predicates:
WorksInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromCSDept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakesDatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedBy(x, y) ::: x is instructed by y.
WorksInLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Question:
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? James has a part-time job offered by the university.
Premises:
¬∃x (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x)) ∧ ∀x (HasPartTimeJob(x) → WorksInLibrary(x)) ∧ ∀x (TakesDatabaseCourse(x) → FromCSDept(x)) ∧ ∀x (InstructedBy(x, professorDavid) → TakesDatabaseCourse(x)) ∧ ∀x (WorksInLab(x) → InstructedBy(x, professorDavid)) ∧ Student(james) ∧ WorksInLab(james) ∧ Jack(¬HasPartTimeJob(jack)) ∧ ¬WorksInLab(jack)
